reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness diagnostics plugin that inspects available agent capabilities, providers, skills, workspaces, and session persistence while reporting warnings without modifying configuration or exposing credentials.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的只读运行时诊断插件，可检查智能体能力、工具、模型、技能、工作区和会话持久化状态并报告问题。
summaries.en: A read-only DeepSeek Harness runtime diagnostics plugin that checks agent capabilities, tools, models, skills, workspaces, and session persistence and reports detected issues.

capabilities: Read-only inspection of runtime, tools, models, skills, workspaces, sessions, and capability errors
